why: Rewrites the unstyled test as "this slot has no paint-shop entry", which reads the same and also catches slot 0: an unpainted P1 then wears the unstyled fallback, and since slot 0 has no versus shade that is the placeholder in every mode. Issue #1124 leaves slot 0 on its roster hull #3d7bd6. No older test in entities.test.ts reads an unpainted P1's hull, single-player included, so this survived (0 of 124 failed before #1124's tests existed) until #1124's literal pin, whose slot-0 column is what this entry names. The High contrast sweep fails too, as a side effect: the placeholder in slot 0 sits 13.57 from that palette's hull 2 (colour-distance.ts, 2026-10-25).
